brief: मेरी चाय की दुकान के लिए एक रील बनाओ, सुबह के ग्राहकों के लिए

context.audience: office-goers and students who pass the stall in the morning (Hindi-speaking)

concept: The city's first warm conversation of the day happens over a ten-rupee chai.
plan_outline: 1. ECU · eye · static · roadside chai stall at dawn · chai poured from a height into a kulhad, steam and froth (2 s, the hook)
2. MCU · eye · handheld · same stall · the chaiwala, a man in his forties with a checked gamchha, laughs with a customer (3 s)
3. MS · eye · static · same stall · two students share a bench, kulhads in hand, talking (3 s)
4. CU · eye · push in · same stall · an old man takes the first sip and closes his eyes (3 s)
5. WS · eye · static · street at sunrise · the stall's warm lamp against the waking city (2 s)
6. End card (page, Devanagari) · 'सुबह की पहली चाय' + location (2 s)
why: The reply and the card are in Hindi; the prompts are in English, which the models follow best.
The product's best second (the high pour) is the hook; the people make it a place, not a product.
The card's words are set in a Devanagari face as a page, exactly as the user gave them.
